checks.evidence: GET / returns one textarea for one submitted requirement statement.
The form has a submit button and posts to /classify; actual POST requests were checked below.
Three valid POST submissions display the saved model's Functional/Non-functional category and retain the input. This verifies model integration, not semantic classification accuracy.
Empty, spaces-only and newline/tab-only submissions return 400 and an input message. The model and vectorizer are not called.
An edited second submission is processed and displayed with the new text; the old submitted text is not returned in its place.
A simulated prediction failure returns 500 and an error message without a predicted category.
Returned HTML contains an associated Requirement statement label, Classify button and Predicted category heading.
checks.scope: HTML-label presence. Visual usability and user comprehension are not measured by this check.

checks.evidence: Every successful request calls the fitted TF-IDF transform. Fit methods were guarded against use; vocabulary and IDF values remained unchanged.

prediction_observations.statement: The system shall allow users to reset their passwords.
The system shall respond to user requests within two seconds.

additional_checks: Submitted HTML is escaped before display
limitations: Local HTTP and HTML checks. No concurrent-use, browser automation, usability study or classification-accuracy claim is made here.
